ItemId.description: The stable identifier of the rule. Preserved across environments.

Name.description: The display name of the rule.

Version.description: Ignored on import: each site stamps its own version, incremented on every change.

Priority.description: The evaluation priority. Lower values are evaluated first.

TaxType.description: The type of tax the rule produces (for example 'SalesTax').

TaxName.description: The human readable name of the tax the rule produces.

TaxCode.description: The code of the tax the rule produces.

JurisdictionId.description: The identifier of the jurisdiction the rule belongs to.

CategoryCode.description: The tax category code the rule applies to. Omit to match every category.

CustomerType.description: The customer classification the rule applies to. Omit to match every customer type.

Source.description: The calculation method used by the rule (for example 'Percentage').

Rate.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

FixedAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

TaxTableId.description: The identifier of the tax table the rule uses, when the method is table based.

IncludedInPrice.description: Whether the produced tax is included in the item price.

IsCompound.description: Whether the produced tax is compound (calculated on top of other taxes).

ReverseCharge.description: Whether the recipient accounts for the tax (reverse charge). Produces a zero-amount reverse-charge line when the customer matches.

AppliesToShipping.description: Whether the rule applies to shipping charges.

MinimumAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

MaximumAmount.description: The exclusive maximum taxable amount the rule applies to.

ThresholdBasis.description: What the minimum and maximum amounts are compared with: each item, or the whole order.

EffectiveFromUtc.description: The UTC date the rule stops being effective.

EffectiveToUtc.description: The UTC date the rule stops being effective.

TaxRules.description: The tax rules to create or update.
